description: Reviewed expectations for the complete Littlewild/Wildlands gate. verify.ts and CI accept a complete run only when the observed suites match suites (order included), every suite emits exactly its inventory of uniquely named passing checks, and the total equals totalChecks. totalChecks = historicalBaseline.checks + reviewedAdditions - retirements. A new check must be added to its suite inventory and to reviewedAdditions; a renamed check needs a renames entry (suite/from/to/reason); a removed check needs a retirements entry (suite/name/reason). Never edit historicalBaseline.

historicalBaseline.note: Original 75 registrations and 1,543 named checks; immutable.
